svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json # After Google's Cloud Architecture Center event-driven designs with Eventarc: a Cloud Storage # event and a Pub/Sub message each reach a Cloud Run destination through an Eventarc trigger, # with Document AI for the extraction and Firestore for the records. title: Event-driven document processing on Google Cloud subtitle: Eventarc routes an upload to Cloud Run for Document AI and Firestore, then a Pub/Sub event to the notifier direction: down # Product cards, as in Google Cloud's own architecture diagrams; one port per edge. look: card layout: { merge: false, layering: simplex } legend: solid: Requests and data dashed: Events delivered by Eventarc # Every product here is serverless, so the project is the boundary that matters. groups: gcloud: { type: gcp:cloud } project: { type: gcp:project, label: Project docs-prod, in: gcloud } nodes: users: { icon: generic:users, label: Customers, note: Web and mobile apps } upload: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Cloud Run, note: upload service, in: project } bucket: { icon: gcp:cloud-storage, label: Cloud Storage, note: Uploads bucket, in: project } on-upload: { icon: gcp:eventarc, label: Eventarc, note: Object finalized trigger, in: project } # Beside the extract service rather than under it, so the call is one short line. docai: { icon: gcp:document-ai, label: Document AI, note: Form parser, in: project, align: extract } extract: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Cloud Run, note: extract service, in: project } db: { icon: gcp:firestore, label: Firestore, note: Document records, in: project } topic: { icon: gcp:pubsub, label: Pub/Sub, note: documents-processed topic, in: project } on-processed: { icon: gcp:eventarc, label: Eventarc, note: Pub/Sub trigger, in: project } # Cloud Run functions keeps the Serverless Computing icon the icon guide gives Cloud Functions. notify: { icon: gcp:cloud-functions, label: Cloud Run functions, note: Send notification, in: project } edges: - users -> upload: HTTPS - upload -> bucket: write object - bucket --> on-upload - on-upload --> extract - extract -> docai: process document - extract -> db: save fields - extract -> topic: publish # The notification leg climbs beside the main column: written in layout order with the # arrowhead at the start, so the events still point from Pub/Sub to the notifier. - { from: notify, to: on-processed, arrow: start, line: dashed } - { from: on-processed, to: topic, arrow: start, line: dashed }

svg.title: Event-driven document processing on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Event-driven document processing on Google Cloud. 10 components in 2 groups. Connections: Customers to Cloud Run (HTTPS); Cloud Run to Cloud Storage (write object); Cloud Storage to Eventarc; Eventarc to Cloud Run; Cloud Run to Document AI (process document); Cloud Run to Firestore (save fields); Cloud Run to Pub/Sub (publish); Cloud Run functions to Eventarc; Eventarc to Pub/Sub.

text.tspan: EVENT-DRIVEN DOCUMENT PROCESSING ON GOOGLE CLOUD
Eventarc routes an upload to Cloud Run for Document AI and Firestore, then a Pub/Sub event to the notifier
